claims: The American Idol Season 24 (2026) Top 20 concluded their performances in Hawaii on March 23, 2026.
The American Idol Season 24 (2026) Top 20 performances took place at Disney's Aulani Resort in Hawaii.
Keke Palmer and Brad Paisley were guest mentors for the American Idol Season 24 (2026) Top 20.
The first live show of American Idol Season 24 (2026) is on March 30, 2026.
Voting for the American Idol Season 24 (2026) Top 20 opened after the March 16, 2026 episode.
Voting for the American Idol Season 24 (2026) Top 20 continued through the March 23, 2026 episode.
The results of the voting for the American Idol Season 24 (2026) Top 20 lead into the live show on March 30, 2026.
Braden Rumfelt performed "Love On The Brain".
Keyla Richardson performed in the second group.
